23 May 2027 | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | matches = 5 | total goals = 20 | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | prevseason = [[2025–26 Macedonian First Football League|2025–26]] | nextseason = ''2027–28'' | updated = 26 July 2026 }} The '''2026–27 Macedonian First League''' is the 35th season of the [[Macedonian First Football League]], the highest [[Association football|football]] league of [[North Macedonia]]. This is the first season with the 10 teams since the [[2019–20 Macedonian First Football League|2019–20 season]]. It began on 24 July 2026 and is scheduled to end on 23 May 2027.{{Cite web|url=https://macedonianfootball.com/schedule-for-26-27-season-in-1-mfl-revealed/ |title=Schedule for 26/27 season in 1.MFL revealed|date=10 June 2026 |publisher=MacedonianFootball.com |access-date=15 June 2026}} [[FK Vardar|Vardar]] are the defending champions, having won their twelfth title in [[2025–26 Macedonian First Football League|2025–26]].{{cite web|url=https://macedonianfootball.com/1-mfl-2025-26-standings-fixtures/|title=1.MFL 2025/26 Standings & results|publisher=MacedonianFootball.com|access-date=15 June 2026}}{{cite web|url=https://www.soccerway.com/north-macedonia/1-mfl-2025-2026|title=1.
